complete_paragraph: Within a [technical and ethical encounter](episteme/conjugate/AC.md), an internality's representation belongs among the contents available for examination. In a local act, the judging agent is the relative functional knower; its memory, model, rules, tools and context are means; the situation and alternatives it discriminates are its known field. Those offices arise together in the determination. Within the containing person’s inquiry, the complete apparatus itself participates in the means. A further inspection makes that local centre, its rule or self-description known in another act. The first-person condition of the inspecting act remains active through the inspection; adding represented contents cannot convert that condition into another object among them. Recovering the local centre together with its means, known field and containing inquiry makes the instrument more legible and more capable of return. An encountered discrepancy can correct an answer, task or model under a fitting criterion, or expose a source, rule, permission or commission which needs revision. A fitting condition can be retained with reasons. The next act inherits that warranted correction or retention, while another person’s answer remains capable of changing the account through which they were approached.
